guaranteed_counts.formulas: packages = ceil(N/500); per package local index k (module = floor(k/20)): k%20==0 is a barrel (index.ts re-exporting the module's live files); k%10==7 (not a barrel) is a dead file (imported by nothing, not re-exported); the highest-k live file of each package is the entry (imported by nothing); every other file is imported at least once; live files with k%10==3 also export an unused const (unused_exports). Exact for N a multiple of 500; other N gets the same rules on a shorter last package -- generated.json in the output has the real counts.
guaranteed_counts.expected_reach01_unreferenced_files: dead_files + entry_files (2040 at N=20000) unless the entries are declared as Knip entry points

notes: Output is NOT committed. Deterministic (fixed PRNG seed): same N gives byte-identical output. 20000 files generate in ~2.5 s. Output contains package.json (typescript 5.9.3, no lockfile), tsconfig.json, generated.json and packages/pkg-NNN/src/mod-NN/*.ts.
